text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "SECO", "gist": "Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Direction de la promotion économique du SECO", "gist": "SECO's Economic Promotion Division"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "1er septembre 2024", "gist": "September 1, 2024"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "5 ans", "gist": "5 years"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "25 ans", "gist": "25 years"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "2004 à 2011", "gist": "2004 to 2011"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Tanzanie et au Ghana", "gist": "Tanzania and Ghana"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il a pris la direction du secteur Développement du secteur privé en 2010", "gist": "He took over the Private Sector Development sector in 2010"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il a été nommé chef des Opérations Sud/Est en janvier 2013", "gist": "He was appointed Head of South/East Operations in January 2013"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il est à la tête de la Direction de la promotion économique du SECO depuis le 1er septembre 2024", "gist": "He has been heading the Economic Promotion Division of SECO since September 1, 2024"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il a exercé pendant 5 ans les fonctions de chef opérationnel et de chef suppléant du centre de prestations Coopération et développement économiques", "gist": "He served for 5 years as operational head and deputy head of the Economic Cooperation and Development Services center"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il s’est consacré durant plus de 25 ans aux questions en lien avec la coopération économique internationale au développement", "gist": "He dedicated over 25 years to international economic cooperation for development"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "De 2004 à 2011, il a dirigé les programmes de coopération du SECO en Tanzanie et au Ghana", "gist": "From 2004 to 2011, he led SECO's cooperation programs in Tanzania and Ghana"}]}
